read-only: This booking can no longer be edited because of its status.
total-help: Saved with the booking, so later rate changes do not alter it.
not-found: This booking does not exist in the active property.
checked-in-locked: Checked-in bookings cannot be cancelled or marked as no-show.
no-show-confirmed-only: Only confirmed bookings can be marked as no-show.
pending-help: Check the dates, room, and guest contact before confirming the booking.
